name: Sensei, Mazo Mazo Sasete? ~Ojou-sama no Kagai Jugyou~
original_name: 先生、マゾマゾさせて？ ～お嬢様の課外授業～
source:
Tatsuya is a new teacher and because of him being the newcomer, all the senior teachers push their work onto him.

He is placed in charge of the suggestions box, a place where students can give ideas to help make the school a better place.
While reading the letters from the suggestions box, he finds a letter that was a lewd confession more than a suggestion.

It couldn't be THAT girl, Tatsuya thinks to himself. The frequency of lewd letters increases.
One day he finds a letter that was a plain invitation, "I'll be waiting".
Tatsuya heads to the promised place and...​
translation:
达也是新老师，因为他是新人，所有前辈老师的工作都推给了他。

他负责管理意见箱，学生们可以在这里提出意见，帮助学校变得更好。
在阅读建议箱中的信件时，他发现一封信与其说是建议，不如说是猥亵的忏悔。

不可能是那个女孩吧，达也心里想。淫秽信件的频率增加。
有一天，他发现了一封简单的邀请信，“我会等待”。
达也前往约定的地点……​
